tools.name: koncerty_zespolu
tools.description: Upcoming concerts of one band in Poland (date, city, club, line-up, link). Case and Polish letters do not matter; an exact band name is matched first, otherwise any name containing the text.

tools.name: koncerty_w_miescie
tools.description: Concerts in a Polish city (or in all of Poland when no city is given) between two dates, optionally one genre. Without dates: the next 14 days.
